[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/wolfmqtt-fuzzers/fuzzer.cpp","function":"wolfMQTTFuzzer::Initialize","line":188,"var":"connect->protocol_level","code":"MqttClient_Connect(client, connect)","note":"The fuzzer configures the client for MQTT v5, enabling property parsing on incoming packets."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/wolfmqtt-fuzzers/fuzzer.cpp","function":"wolfMQTTFuzzer::recv","line":503,"var":"data","code":"const auto data = ds.GetData(0); memcpy(buf, data.data(), copySize);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into the network receive buffer and become the raw packet stream."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/wolfmqtt/src/mqtt_client.c","function":"MqttClient_WaitMessage","line":842,"var":"client->rx_buf","code":"rc = MqttClient_DecodePacket(client, client->rx_buf, ...)","note":"The received bytes are dispatched to the packet decoder as an incoming MQTT message."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/wolfmqtt/src/mqtt_client.c","function":"MqttClient_DecodePacket","line":750,"var":"p_auth->props","code":"rc = MqttDecode_Auth(rx_buf, rx_len, p_auth); if (rc >= 0 && doProps) { int tmp = Handle_Props(client, p_auth->props, ... , 1); }","note":"For an AUTH packet, the decoder parses properties and then unconditionally hands the parsed list to Handle_Props for cleanup."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/wolfmqtt/src/mqtt_packet.c","function":"MqttDecode_Auth","line":1748,"var":"auth->props","code":"tmp = MqttDecode_Vbi(rx_payload, &props_len, ...); if (props_len > 0) tmp = MqttDecode_Props(..., &auth->props, rx_payload, ..., props_len);","note":"The AUTH packet's property-length field controls whether a property list is decoded from attacker bytes."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/wolfmqtt/src/mqtt_packet.c","function":"MqttDecode_Props","line":500,"var":"cur_prop","code":"cur_prop = MqttProps_Add(props); ... rc = MqttDecode_Vbi(buf, (word32*)&cur_prop->type, ...);","note":"Each decoded property is allocated from the static property pool and its type is filled from the input stream."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/wolfmqtt/src/mqtt_packet.c","function":"MqttProps_Free","line":1892,"var":"head->type","code":"while (head != NULL) { head->type = MQTT_PROP_NONE; head = head->next; }","note":"Cleanup walks the decoded list and marks each node free without unlinking or validating that the list nodes are still valid."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/wolfmqtt/src/mqtt_client.c","function":"Handle_Props","line":527,"var":"props","code":"if (free_props) { MqttProps_Free(props); }","note":"Handle_Props forwards the attacker-influenced property list to the free routine, which is the memory-safety sink reached on the crashing path."}
]
JSON
